notes.title: Added Xbox controller support to gameplay
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added xbox controller support for gameplay, menus not supported. a to interact, dpad and left thumbstick to move
[*]Fixed issue with transition not playing from lv 4 to 5
[*]Increased amount of points needed to win level 2, as if you got enough points before the drone event the time after was very short
[*]Fixed issue with powerup sound playing after level 5 into final scene.
[/list]
